toolCall.argumentsJson: {"CommandLine":"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command \"Get-CimInstance Win32_PnPEntity | Where-Object { $_.DeviceID -match 'VID_0B05' -or $_.DeviceID -match 'VID_043E' -or $_.DeviceID -match 'VID_0BDA' } | Select-Object Name, Description, DeviceID, Manufacturer | Format-List\"","Cwd":"C:\\AI-BS","WaitMsBeforeAsync":5000,"toolAction":"Checking PnP Device details","toolSummary":"Check PnP details for Asus and controllers"}
